newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss six-month money market claims yield 1.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss six-month money market claims yield 1.95 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government six-month money market claims is 1.950 percent.
The yield on the previous issue, a tranche of three-month claims, was 1.940 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on September 12, raised 850.40 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.024 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on September 5, raised 1,287.15 million and was priced at 99.512 percent. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
